title: Arch journal cap 300M -> 4G, vacuum only past the cap
objective: The systemd journal keeps weeks of history on kuhy's desktop, not days: a 300M cap held about two days once one Steam boot wrote 480k lines, and the evidence for a curfew failure was gone when it was needed. Every Arch copy of the journal tweak installs a 4G cap and treats 'large' as past that cap.
acceptance_criteria: fix_arch_performance.sh, optimize_arch_desktop.sh and the perf report write SystemMaxUse=4G and vacuum to 4G only when usage is >= 4G
a journal measured in megabytes, or under 4G, is neither vacuumed nor reported as large
test_arch_hardware_boot.sh, test_arch_perf_fixes.sh, test_arch_perf_report_fixes.sh and test_arch_perf_report.sh pass unchanged in count
out_of_scope: the Ubuntu copy of the same fix (ubuntu_perf_more.sh) -- not this machine
rate-limiting the Steam flood itself -- fixed at source in steam-backlog-enforcer
